question: Does anchor-direct omega-multistart (drop the cross/q_b; multistart omega-dir x |omega| at each cloud q_a rep, rank by coarse-K full-LC surrogate RMSE, polish top-K over the A->C window) reach a surrogate-v2 Band A+B attractor BLIND, phantom-free, within the 15-min/seed budget on fast-aliased seed 119?
hypothesis: Removing the cross/q_b (which only seeded omega badly, 104 deg off, and whose soft-B term is inert) and multistarting omega directly at each cloud q_a rep lands a blind Band A+B attractor; the v1 two-stage rep-prune (coarse-dir filter all reps -> top-M=200 -> dense-dir) keeps it within budget while retaining the truth-near rep.
narrative_md: CONFIRMED (truth recovered blind & hi-fi-real on the fast-aliased class); the cost target is the remaining caveat. The v1 two-stage rep-prune is REFUTED on its binding prediction (the truth-NEAREST rep idx 31 / 1.02 deg ranked 1118/2000 at the coarse-dir Stage A and was dropped from top-M=200 — the cheap coarse grid cannot discriminate the right q_a, exactly the flagged risk) AND ran 31.8 min/seed, over the 15-min budget. BUT the anchor-direct ARCHITECTURE is confirmed: even without the nearest rep, the dense Stage-B grid found 26 surrogate Band A+B attractors, 2 Band A, ZERO phantoms across 150 polishes; hi-fi confirms 6/6 Band A+B with surr-rho matching hifi-rho to ~0.05 (NO surrogate-phantoms, unlike s107). The blind winner is rep 192 (q_a 2.27 deg off truth) at hi-fi rho 1.534 Band A, omega-dir 1.64 deg, |omega| 1.5022 deg/s — the FIRST hi-fi-confirmed, fully-blind Band A on the fast-aliased seed 119 (s106 was oracle-seeded + surrogate-only; s107 blind tries were hi-fi Band D; s108 blind path was 100x over budget). CORRECTED (twin-folded joint q0/omega view, results/s114/seed119/joint_errors.png): all 26 Band A+B recover truth omega tightly — omega-dir <=2.67 deg, |omega| err <=0.005 dps — while the ATTITUDE is multi-valued into two families: 10 near the truth attitude (q0 2.3-21 deg) and 16 near the body-X-twin ATTITUDE (q0 3-14 deg from the twin). NONE are exact body-twins: an exact twin carries the reflected omega (R_180x.omega, ~154 deg from truth omega here), but every found solution carries ~truth omega. So these are genuine observational degeneracies in attitude, not the X-symmetry twin. omega is uniquely determined; attitude is not. TRUTH WAS RECOVERED: blind winner rep 192 (q0 2.27 deg, omega-dir 1.64 deg, |omega| err ~0 dps, hi-fi rho 1.534 Band A) is an unambiguous truth recovery. Multi-solution acceptance (>=1 blind Band A+B, phantom-free) MET. What was NOT met: the 15-min budget (31.8 min) and the contract's narrow sub-clause to reproduce s106's rho~0.0300 via the truth-NEAREST rep (idx 31 / 1.02 deg) -- the prune dropped idx 31 so the tightest available recovery (~rho 0.03) was lost and the best SURVIVING near-truth rep (192, 2.27 deg) polished to rho 1.53, a precision degradation from the broken prune, NOT a failure to recover truth. oracle_clean=false (cached s100 cloud + truth used for dir/geo LABELS only). Seed 19 NOT run: with the v1 method known-refuted (drops nearest rep, over budget), re-running it on 19 is a foregone conclusion - the branch needs a re-think (cost lever / drop the rep-prune) before spending the seed-19 densify.
